_comment: Checked-in marks for the es-toolkit CI regression gate (see .github/workflows/ci.yml `es-toolkit-regression` and scripts/check_library_gate.py). `probe_blockers` is the number of source files with at least one blocker (probe.json `files_with_blockers`); the gate fails if it rises. `check_errors`/`test_build_errors` are gated at a hard zero by cargo exit code in the workflow. `runtime_passed` is the floor of passing tests and `runtime_known_failures` the only tests allowed to fail; both block. `warning_count` is advisory only. Improvements pass without a bump; loosening any mark is manual-only with PR justification, mirroring the SmeltUnknown-enforcement rule.
